slices.objective: Return the single highest-severity verdict among BLOCKER > FAIL > PARTIAL > PASS found in a list of per-finding classification strings, matched case-insensitively after stripping whitespace. Unrecognized or empty entries are ignored and duplicates do not change the result. An empty list, or a list with no recognized entries, returns PASS. The result is always exactly 'PASS', 'PARTIAL', 'FAIL', or 'BLOCKER'. Used by tools/playtest/summarize_session.py to roll up first-loop playtest findings.
acceptance: tools/playtest/verdict_rollup.py defines a single pure function rollup_playtest_verdict(findings: list[str]) -> str with no file, path, stream, clock, random or network input; it only operates on the list of strings passed to it.

The function ranks BLOCKER above FAIL above PARTIAL above PASS, compares case-insensitively after stripping whitespace, ignores unrecognized or empty entries, and returns PASS for an empty list or a list with no recognized entries.
tools/test_*.py adds deterministic unit tests covering the empty-list, mixed-case, duplicate-entries, and unrecognized-entry cases, all passing under the existing Python test runner.
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review pass at the exact head.

acceptance_examples.why: An empty findings list has nothing blocking, so it returns the default PASS verdict.
BLOCKER outranks every other classification regardless of case, so it wins the rollup.
Duplicate FAIL entries in different cases do not change the result, which stays the highest distinct severity.
An unrecognized entry is ignored and surrounding whitespace is stripped before matching, leaving PASS as the only recognized verdict.
